comment: Every pre-recorded narrator line in Moonfall. Each id maps to an array of phrasing variants; the game picks one at random per playback so no two rounds sound the same. Files are named <id>.<variant>.mp3. Regenerate with scripts/generate_voice_pack.py.
delivery: Written for Eleven v3, which reads inline [square-bracket] audio tags as delivery direction rather than speaking them. Engines that do not understand tags have them stripped before synthesis, so every line still reads as clean prose. House style: short beats, concrete nouns, wildly uneven line lengths. The narrator sets the mood and issues the one instruction the phase needs — the screen prints nothing the voice already said.

nightfall: [whispers] Night comes down like a lid. Close your eyes.
The lamps go out, one by one. Close your eyes, Moonfall.
[ominous] Something is already awake. Close your eyes.
cue-role-reveal: The cards are dealt. Learn what you are — and never say it aloud.
cue-setup-thief: [whispers] Thief. Two fates went unclaimed. Take one, or keep your own.
cue-setup-cupid: Cupid, open your eyes. Choose two hearts. What you tie tonight, only death unties.
cue-setup-lovers: Open your eyes. The arrow has flown. Turn your card: is your heart still your own?
cue-night-seer: [whispers] Seer. One face. One truth. Choose.
Seer, open your eyes. The moon will show you a single soul, and no more.
cue-night-wolves: [ominous] The pack is awake. Find your kin, and agree on who does not see the morning.
[whispers] Werewolves. Open your eyes. Someone here has stopped being safe.
cue-night-witch: Witch. Here lies tonight's work. One bottle saves. One bottle ends.
[whispers] Witch, open your eyes. See what the pack has done. Let it stand, or do not.
cue-sheriff-vote: Choose a Sheriff. One voice here is about to weigh twice as much as yours.
cue-day-discussion: Talk. Accuse. Defend. [whispers] One of these faces is lying to you.
The square is yours. Somewhere in it, the pack is smiling.
cue-day-vote: Point. There is no taking it back.
[solemn] Cast your judgement. The village does not get to be sorry afterwards.
cue-hunter-shot: [dramatic] The Hunter falls — and the barrel comes up anyway. One shot. Choose.
cue-sheriff-successor: The Sheriff is dying. Press the badge into someone's hand.
sleep-night-wolves: The wolves fold back into the village.
dawn-none: Every door opened. Every face answered. Nobody died.
The village counts itself, and finds itself whole.
dawn-death: [solemn] One door stayed shut this morning.
The night did not leave empty-handed.
vote-tied: Split down the middle. Nobody hangs today.
vote-none: No one pointed. The village keeps its hands clean, for now.
vote-death: [solemn] The village has spoken. Step forward.
The tally closes, and one name stands alone.
role-werewolf: [ominous] A Werewolf. Among you. All along.
role-hunter: The Hunter, of the last shot.
role-thief: The Thief, in a stolen life.
win-village: [triumphant] The last wolf falls. Moonfall belongs to the living.
win-wolves: [ominous] No one is left to bar a door. The village belongs to the pack.
win-lovers: Everyone else is gone. Two hearts, still beating, still tied. Love wins.
win-none: [solemn] Nothing stirs. Not one soul survived the tale.
